author: tedcruz
text:
Heidi and I are lifting Neria Leiter up in prayer after he was gravely wounded in today’s terrorist attack.

The Leiter family has already endured unimaginable loss. We pray that God places His healing hand on Neria, gives him strength, and brings comfort and peace to the entire Leiter family.
